# Spatial outputs {#sec-maps}

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(ecoSynthesis)
library(sf)
library(terra)

library(readr)
library(fasterize)
library(dplyr)

here::i_am("EFG-map.qmd")
TASVEG <- read_sf(here::here("gisdata", "TASVEG_5_0.shp"))
xref <- read_csv(here::here("output-XREFs/First-round-output.csv"))

sum_membs <- xref |>
  group_by(VEGCODE) |>
  summarise(
    k = sum(if_else(efg == "TF1.3", memb, 0)),
    total = sum(memb),
    prop = k / total
  )

TASVEG_k <- TASVEG |> left_join(sum_membs, by = "VEGCODE")


TASVEG_rast <- rast(TASVEG, res = 10000)
TASVEG_raster <- raster(TASVEG, res = 10000)

k_rast <- rasterize(TASVEG_k, TASVEG_rast, field = "prop", fun = "sum")
k_raster <- fasterize(TASVEG_k, TASVEG_raster, field = "prop", fun = "sum")

out_dir <- here::here("gisout")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir)
}

sum(values(k_rast), na.rm = TRUE)
sum(k_raster@data@values, na.rm = T)
plot(k_raster)

out_file <- here::here(out_dir, "TF1_3-rasterize.tiff")
writeRaster(k_raster, out_file)

out_file <- here::here(out_dir, "TF1_3-fasterize.tiff")
writeRaster(k_rast, out_file)


bench <- microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  terrarize = k_rast <- rasterize(
    TASVEG_k,
    TASVEG_rast,
    field = "prop",
    fun = "sum"
  ),
  fasterize = k_raster <- fasterize(
    TASVEG_k,
    TASVEG_raster,
    field = "prop",
    fun = "sum"
  ),
  unit = "ms"
)

print(bench, digits = 3)
```

 ```{r}
 #| eval: false
out_dir <- here::here("gisout")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) {
   dir.create(out_dir
})

rez <- 10000 / 100
rez <- 90
TASVEG_raster <- raster(TASVEG, res = rez)

for (tid in IUCN_GET_LUT$efg_id) {
   cat(sprintf("Starting %s: %s // ", tid, date()))
   out_file <- here::here(out_dir ,sprintf("%s-res%s.tiff", tid, rez))
   if (file.exists(out_file)) {
     cat(sprintf("%s already exists\n", out_file))
   } else {
     if (tid %in% xref$efg) {
       sum_membs <- xref | 
         group_by(VEGCODE) | 
         summarise(
           k = sum(if_else(efg == tid, memb, 0)),
           total = sum(memb),
           prop =  k /tota
        )

       TASVEG_k <- TASVEG |> left_join(sum_membs, b y ="VEGCODE")
       k_raster <- fasterize
        (TASVEG_k
       , TASVEG_raster
       , fiel d ="prop"
       , fun = "sum
      )

       print(sum(k_raster@data@values ,na.r m =T))
       plot(k_raster)
 
       writeRaster(k_raster, out_file)
     } else {
       cat(sprintf("%s not found\n", tid))
     }
   }
}
 ```

 ```{r}
library(terra)
here::i_am("synthesis/EFG-map.qmd")
out_dir <- here::here("gisout")
tas_all <- rast(dir(out_dir, pattern = "res90", full.names = TRUE))

tas_which <- app(tas_all, fun = "which.max")
tas_max <- app(tas_all, fun = "max")
plot(tas_which)
plot(tas_max)
 ```
